item: Attribution rule has no branch for complex-fold-only lesions
detail: derive_expected_mech_class folds isolated-fold and complex-fold into one class, but the attribution rule checks the isolated axis only, so BRCA1 C61G cannot be credited though its complex-fold axis fires at 6.78. Crediting it moves attribution 14 -> 15 of 29. A published metric, so your call.
